source_evidence: For accepted orders the warehouse picks the parts, packs the order and books a carrier.
problem: The warehouse department is marked as an automated authority rather than a human organisational performer.

source_evidence:
The warehouse also does quality inspection and labelling for each order, but nobody could
say whether those happen before or after packing, or in which order relative to each other.
problem: The map fixes quality inspection between picking and packing despite the source explicitly leaving its order unknown.
correction: Remove pick-parts--quality-inspection and quality-inspection--pack-order and their incoming/outgoing references, connect pick-parts directly to pack-order, and leave quality-inspection unconnected with an annotation declaring its unknown order relative to packing and labelling.

map_evidence.quote: <bpmn:task id="send-payment-reminder" name="Send payment reminder"><bpmn:documentation>source: "The ERP sends a payment reminder after seven days."</bpmn:documentation>

problem: The map adds an unsupported payment-reminder task after invoicing and attributes it to a fabricated source quotation.
correction: Remove send-payment-reminder, its lane reference and both incident flows; connect generate-and-send-invoice directly to accepted-order-fulfilled and update incoming/outgoing references.
